Welcome to the course: in this lecture, we begin by turning a problem statement into a small program.

```cpp
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
  int a, b;
  cin >> a >> b;
  cout << a + b << '\n';
}
```

```python
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b)
```
